programme.title: 小動物狠角色:17
programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:十腿惡霸.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是美國內華達州岩漠裡的避日蛛牠的體重只有5.7公克，相當於兩枚一分錢硬幣的重量，但牠卻能產生比自己體重還多一百倍以上的咬力，把獵物咬成碎片之後，還會把酸性的消化酵素吐在獵物身上，讓獵物分解成液體狀肉湯，簡直就是沙漠裡的迷你惡魔

programme.title: 小動物狠角色:18
programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:吸力超強.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是泰國南部雨林裡的大守宮牠的外觀非常精緻，有各種顏色的斑點點綴著或淺或深的底色；除此之外，牠的神奇腳趾上還有奇妙的細毛，讓牠能緊緊附著在任何表面，垂直攀爬的速度更是快得嚇人這個神奇的特徵也啟發了最先進的科技發明，讓人類能在光滑的垂直表面攀爬

programme.title: 狗狗101第3季:2
programme.desc: 狗狗101第3季:天性夜貓子.巴生吉犬來自於歷史悠久的古埃及，嗅覺與視覺皆相當良好，獨立溫和，由於不愛吠叫因此適合養在都市中鬥牛獒犬顯示出極大的力量耐性和機敏，也具有沉穩忠實富有感情的性格現在多使用於軍警界喜樂蒂牧羊犬犬多數是明朗活潑，但與工作犬比較之下，個性較纖細神經質要每天梳整及注意運動，即可成為絕佳的家犬美國愛斯基摩犬是嚴寒地帶既積極又勤力的工作犬，結構緊湊且非常勻稱，體質良好棉花面紗犬起源於17世紀認為是法國軍團將含有比熊血統的品種帶到馬達加斯加島，現在該島已經成為該品種的培育地，這種高貴溫順機靈的犬種在美國越來越受到歡迎大庇里牛斯犬具有很強的忍耐力與很高的警覺性擁有威嚴身驅溫柔的臉龐與柔軟的披毛，個性卻非常溫馴忠實

programme.title: 警犬出動:8
programme.desc: 警犬出動:並肩作戰.賽門哈利斯警員帶偵搜犬比利出任務，調查涉及毒品交易的車輛，比利從狹小的藏匿處找出分裝的大麻，顯然罪嫌企圖裝袋販售，非個人使用

programme.title: 最萌寵物秀
programme.desc: 最萌寵物秀.節目介紹許多可愛又特別的寵物，牠們帶給人們無限的歡樂，也讓人們感受到牠們旺盛的生命鬥志例如兩隻原本無家可歸的吉娃娃犬坎卡和魯，天生就沒有前腿，但牠們沒有懷憂喪志，總是跳來跳去穿上衣服展現萌樣，甚至為流浪犬認養的服裝比賽活動擔任評審還有紐約州長島的流浪犬探戈，成為第一隻進入港邊跳遠冠軍賽的鬥牛犬，打敗了許多純種拉布拉多獵犬和覓拾犬，也破除許多人對鬥牛犬的成見

programme.title: 小動物狠角色:19
programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:優雅劊子手.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是莫三比克中部的魔花螳螂光是看到這種名稱，就能想見這種螳螂肯定非常威猛，而牠也確實名不虛傳，除了可以跳出將近十倍身長的距離，還能舉起比自己體重多五倍的獵物，一把將獵物抓起後就直接吞下肚子，獵物甚至還沒死亡呢

programme.title: 小動物狠角色:20
programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:毒素地雷.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些小怪物卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是寮國的鱷魚蠑螈，這種蠑螈就像全身都覆蓋了毒素地雷，神奇的毒囊一受到刺激就會噴出毒素；更厲害的是，只要牠的頭部和脊椎保持完整，就算手腳斷掉都能再重新長回來，幾乎可以達到永生不死的境界

programme.title: 動物家族保衛戰
programme.desc: 動物家族保衛戰.在動物界，繁殖與守護後代的本能凌駕於一切每一種動物都發展出獨特的策略來完成使命，展現出創意且令人驚嘆的解方

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:14
programme.desc: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:鬃貓的新家.在這集的布朗克斯動物園裡，一開始要介紹一隻紅領狐猴伊瑞，牠因樹枝穿刺而受傷，第一次治療時因為疏失而沒找到真正原因，但確認病因治療後，牠也逐漸康復；接著要介紹的是鬃貓，園內幫一對鬃貓配對，但得先幫牠們製作展區，展區製作完後牠們就可登場；另外還介紹了一些亞洲閉殼龜，希望藉此喚醒人們對烏龜的保育意識

programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:毒素地雷.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些小怪物卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是寮國的鱷魚蠑螈，這種蠑螈就像全身都覆蓋了毒素地雷，神奇的毒囊一受到刺激就會噴出毒素；更厲害的是，只要牠的頭部和脊椎保持完整，就算手腳斷掉都能再重新長回來，幾乎可以達到永生不死的境界

programme.title: 動物家族保衛戰

programme.title: 捕蛇專家:7
programme.desc: 捕蛇專家:野犬之旅.茱莉亞跟丈夫約翰來到卡麗島度假，當地的原住民導遊帶他們踏上澳洲野犬的國度，學習尊重大自然，對野犬敬而遠之

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤:3
programme.desc: 滅絕動物大追蹤:佛羅里達黑狼.本集節目中，野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特，將前往佛羅里達的艾弗格雷茲沼澤，尋找神秘的黑色大型掠食動物當地的目擊者說牠是黑豹，但北美黑豹的存在從來沒經過證實，另一種可能是佛羅里達黑狼，但這種生物早已被宣告滅絕佛瑞斯特能解開謎團，揭露神秘黑色動物的真面目嗎？

programme.title: 狗狗101第3季:2
programme.desc: 狗狗101第3季:天性夜貓子.巴生吉犬來自於歷史悠久的古埃及，嗅覺與視覺皆相當良好，獨立溫和，由於不愛吠叫因此適合養在都市中鬥牛獒犬顯示出極大的力量耐性和機敏，也具有沉穩忠實富有感情的性格現在多使用於軍警界喜樂蒂牧羊犬犬多數是明朗活潑，但與工作犬比較之下，個性較纖細神經質要每天梳整及注意運動，即可成為絕佳的家犬美國愛斯基摩犬是嚴寒地帶既積極又勤力的工作犬，結構緊湊且非常勻稱，體質良好棉花面紗犬起源於17世紀認為是法國軍團將含有比熊血統的品種帶到馬達加斯加島，現在該島已經成為該品種的培育地，這種高貴溫順機靈的犬種在美國越來越受到歡迎大庇里牛斯犬具有很強的忍耐力與很高的警覺性擁有威嚴身驅溫柔的臉龐與柔軟的披毛，個性卻非常溫馴忠實

programme.title: 警犬出動:8
programme.desc: 警犬出動:並肩作戰.賽門哈利斯警員帶偵搜犬比利出任務，調查涉及毒品交易的車輛，比利從狹小的藏匿處找出分裝的大麻，顯然罪嫌企圖裝袋販售，非個人使用

programme.title: 狗狗101第3季:3
programme.desc: 狗狗101第3季:大螢幕寵兒.澳洲牧牛犬被培育來協助農夫放牧牛羊，目前這個忠實的犬種在牧場上依舊受歡迎，但或許會想趕幼童，因此不適合有幼童的家庭沙路奇獵犬是以速度聞名的異國視覺型獵犬，牠來自中東，在穆斯林世界備受尊崇諾威奇梗犬是聰明的犬種，在電視廣告與電影界深受歡迎，也受到名流仕紳的喜愛帕金獵犬是一流的獵犬，由南卡羅萊納州的戶外獵人培育，牠們在該州深受喜愛，是南卡羅萊納的州狗，在獵鴨季節經常看見牠們的蹤影，也被印製在郵票上鬥牛梗的外表強悍，幸好不擅長打鬥，而是成功的寵物，史巴茲麥肯西協助賣百威淡啤酒，魯法斯則是史上最戰功彪炳的展場狗喀地干威爾斯柯基犬是獨特的小狗，被培育來放牧大型動物，目前牠們主要是玩賞犬，適合與小孩相處

programme.title: 警犬出動:9
programme.desc: 警犬出動:排除萬難.英國的領犬員和他們的警犬搭檔有時出生入死，在工作中也經常遭遇許多困難員警大衛麥肯泰爾的警犬搭檔魯迪是一隻德國狼犬，參與攻堅行動行動時會大聲吠叫，恫嚇壞人，但大衛在幾次訓練中發現牠的表現有些異狀因為擔心牠的身體不適，所以大衛決定帶牠去獸醫院檢查，赫然發現牠的前列腺有腫脹，必須進一步檢查是否罹患癌症；在等待檢查結果的一週時間，對大衛是無法承受的煎熬，儘管後來得知是囊腫發炎破裂，但醫生認為魯迪必須開刀切除囊腫，這對於魯迪的警犬生涯更添一大變數

programme.title: 百變水族箱第8季:14
programme.desc: 百變水族箱第8季:救難英雄.野火肆虐加州索諾馬郡，火災波及森林農場住家，造成人畜傷亡和流離失所科丁鎮購物中心想打造一個大水族箱，將被野火焚毀的社區地標紅穀倉永遠保留在水族箱裡，同時放入受野火摧毀嚴重的當地物種赤杉，以及逃過焚毀命運的LOVE雕塑以這個水族箱紀念購物中心的創始人，同時向火災發生時，英勇的的緊急應變人員與消防員致敬

programme.title: 走出首爾-南韓的自然奇觀:2
programme.desc: 走出首爾-南韓的自然奇觀:第2集.南韓偏遠島嶼與濕地孕育獨特自然與人文風景，居民靠農漁維生傳承技藝

programme.title: 最萌寵物秀
programme.desc: 最萌寵物秀.節目介紹許多可愛又特別的寵物，牠們帶給人們無限的歡樂，也讓人們感受到牠們旺盛的生命鬥志例如兩隻原本無家可歸的吉娃娃犬坎卡和魯，天生就沒有前腿，但牠們沒有懷憂喪志，總是跳來跳去穿上衣服展現萌樣，甚至為流浪犬認養的服裝比賽活動擔任評審還有紐約州長島的流浪犬探戈，成為第一隻進入港邊跳遠冠軍賽的鬥牛犬，打敗了許多純種拉布拉多獵犬和覓拾犬，也破除許多人對鬥牛犬的成見

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第3季:9
programme.desc: 熱血獸醫師第3季:永不放棄.傑夫醫生帶著獸醫團隊重返墨西哥，這是他每年都會安排的旅程，為墨西哥的偏鄉地區從事免費獸醫服務，而且這次他的團隊甚至前往從未踏足過的地區因為墨西哥的貧苦人家連自己都可能養不起，更遑論將貓狗寵物送去做絕育手術但貓狗的繁殖力非常強，當飼主養不起而棄養時，就會造成嚴重的流浪貓狗問題傑夫醫生的策略就是帶領一群當地醫生，在短時間內完成大量的貓狗20個絕育手術，這樣才能有效地降低對當地的流浪貓狗數量一群認同傑夫醫生的墨西哥獸醫，長期加入這個活動，共同為墨西哥的偏鄉獸醫服務盡一份力

programme.title: 野地暖春:1
programme.desc: 野地暖春:第1集.該系列節目探討了新生命的誕生，以及隨之而來的豐富多樣的育兒方式，因為新生命的到來也帶來了機會

programme.title: 野地求生奇才:2

programme.title: 小動物狠角色:15
programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:飛行部隊.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些小動物卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是泰國竹林裡的獨角仙以昆蟲的標準來說，獨角仙的體型已經非常可觀，這種昆蟲界的摔角選手擁有天生神力，不僅可以用兩支大角夾住與之競爭的同類對手，甚至還能推動比自己體重還多五百倍的木材，大力士的稱號非牠莫屬

programme.title: 小動物狠角色:16
programme.desc: 小動物狠角色:有毒飛彈.嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是泰國的亞洲臭鼩牠的外觀看起來就像老鼠，走起路來也像老鼠，但牠卻是罕見的有毒哺乳類，牠的毒液可以讓獵物麻痺癱瘓，一被牠抓到就沒有逃命的機會；此外，牠急速轉彎的速度和角度，就連羚羊都望塵莫及，簡直就是棕櫚樹林中的彎道女王

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤:3
programme.desc: 滅絕動物大追蹤:佛羅里達黑狼.本集節目中，野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特，將前往佛羅里達的艾弗格雷茲沼澤，尋找神秘的黑色大型掠食動物當地的目擊者說牠是黑豹，但北美黑豹的存在從來沒經過證實，另一種可能是佛羅里達黑狼，但這種生物早已被宣告滅絕佛瑞斯特能解開謎團，揭露神秘黑色動物的真面目嗎？

programme.title: 深海怪鯊之最
programme.desc: 深海怪鯊之最.本集節目集結了深海怪鯊五年來的精華，揭露鯊魚界最奇怪的適應法突變怪眼顎部等介紹了分布於世界各地的劍吻鯊皺腮鯊鎧鯊雙髻鯊象鯊等十多種鯊魚，讚嘆大自然的奇妙之餘，也宣揚環保及動保意識

programme.title: 老虎血脈:2
programme.desc: 老虎血脈:未來的虎王.公虎馬卡蘇爾進入瑪雅的地盤，迫使瑪雅的老虎寶寶四散躲避

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:14
programme.desc: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:鬃貓的新家.在這集的布朗克斯動物園裡，一開始要介紹一隻紅領狐猴伊瑞，牠因樹枝穿刺而受傷，第一次治療時因為疏失而沒找到真正原因，但確認病因治療後，牠也逐漸康復；接著要介紹的是鬃貓，園內幫一對鬃貓配對，但得先幫牠們製作展區，展區製作完後牠們就可登場；另外還介紹了一些亞洲閉殼龜，希望藉此喚醒人們對烏龜的保育意識

programme.title: 美洲大地:5
programme.desc: 美洲大地:冰凍北方.一同探索極北之地狼群北極熊與海象的生存爭鬥，以及夏季降臨時，北美馴鹿遷徙與鮭魚逆流而上的壯闊景象

programme.title: 超能動物:9
programme.desc: 超能動物:超強適應力.介紹就算在最嚴苛的環境都能活得很好適應力超強的動物

programme.desc: 飛天小女警講述三位擁有神奇力量的罪惡剋星花花泡泡及毛毛拯救世界的故事遺傳工程學家尤教授運用科學方法，創造出世界上最完美的小女孩結果就創造了三位模樣可愛，嫉惡如仇，誓與罪犯周旋到底的飛天小女警

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通

programme.title: 見見超級蝙蝠車
programme.desc: 搭配搖滾主題曲，蝙蝠車班姆走上高譚市街頭，運用他的智慧領導技巧以及炫酷工具打擊犯罪

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界
programme.desc: 阿甘妙世界是一齣卡通喜劇，主角是住在平凡的吉吉小鎮卻非常搞怪有趣的華特森（Watterson）一家大部分的故事及圍繞著這個家庭的日常生活發展劇中內容融合現實場景，且部分角色是使用偶戲方式演出

programme.title: 怪盜喬克
programme.desc: 主人公的怪盜JOKER與助手小八一起，不僅要從警察妨礙中逃出生天，還要與怪盜斯佩德女怪盜鑽石女王鬥智鬥勇下，一次次將寶物成功盜走

programme.title: 機甲猛鬥:10
programme.desc: 機甲猛鬥劇情描述一名心善且滿腦子天馬行空創造力的小男孩孟鬥，偶然發現一艘監禁運送著許多反派機器人的宇宙監獄飛船墜毀在地球上，並且結識了其中一台名為機甲球的機器人機甲球具備能將物品機甲化，使其具備高科技的能力，而在孟鬥成功馴服機甲球並成為它的主人後，一人一機決定成為搭檔，攜手追捕其餘在逃的機器罪犯們

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝
programme.desc: 一個超酷的寶寶樂團，即便受到討厭音樂的托兒所保母密切監督，這些音樂控寶貝們仍持續他們充滿歡樂與節奏的冒險， 快和娃娃飛仔 米呦卡羅斯與他們快抓狂的保母朵朵開一起隨著音樂大力搖擺！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go
programme.desc: 少年悍將！GO是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目也是DC系列少年悍將漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現

programme.title: 天兵公園

programme.title: 飛天小女警
programme.desc: 飛天小女警講述三位擁有神奇力量的罪惡剋星花花泡泡及毛毛拯救世界的故事遺傳工程學家尤教授運用科學方法，創造出世界上最完美的小女孩結果就創造了三位模樣可愛，嫉惡如仇，誓與罪犯周旋到底的飛天小女警

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通
programme.desc: 跟著還是小寶寶的兔寶寶太菲鴉以及其他經典的卡通人物，一 起在老婆婆的屋子內展開奇妙的冒險吧!

programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇
programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求,具有純淨水源的陸地拉斯維加斯，但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患,一點也不平靜

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片
programme.desc: 兔巴哥想在午餐時間放音樂給大家聽，但是他的搖擺按鈕卻故障了

programme.title: 小潔的大進擊
programme.desc: 徹底展現她獨立自主的個性及冒險雄心！

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程
programme.desc: 兔巴哥大工程由兔巴哥和蘿拉經營的樂樂工程隊，或許施工品質可能有點令人擔憂，但笑料絕對是貨真價實的！鎖定卡通頻道以免錯過任何精彩笑料！

programme.title: 農場雞動隊
programme.desc: 最不像英雄的英雄小隊農場雞動隊 總是在動物們有危難時跳出來神救援小隊由四隻農場動物外加一顆蛋所組成，他們渴望藉由冒險救援跳脫平凡的農場生活，因此每天總是衝鋒陷陣到處幫忙！

programme.title: 超級蝙蝠車
programme.desc: 蝙蝠俠羅賓以及蝙蝠女孩因一起陰謀而離開蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠電腦於是將她的主機板複製到蝙蝠車上，賦予它們生命剛誕生的超級蝙蝠車隨即展開保衛已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及對抗邪惡敵人 the Legion of Zoom!的重大任務

programme.title: Tom And Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: 湯姆與傑利推出全新動畫Tom Jerry Gokko， 畫風更柔和，角色更可愛，追逐場面也變得溫和不少少了以前那種被炸飛被夾扁撞進天花板的誇張打鬥， 多了一點安全感，看起來像是特別為小朋友打造的版本

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go

programme.title: 魅力妻 in Taiwan之魅力無法擋
programme.desc: 因為愛而從日本嫁到語言文化截然不同的台灣，日本太太們除了克服文化差異的困難在台灣扎根，進而深深愛上台灣這塊土地大久保麻梨子隻身在台打拼並成為在台人妻，她與其他日本太太們，一同道出因為文化產生的困難與衝突，抑或是趣事與溫馨在追求幸福生活的路途中發生的種種，都在在展現她們的韌性與獨立

programme.title: 歐兜邁冒險趣
programme.desc: 出川哲郎騎著電動歐兜邁，要想辦法完成指定路線，為了持續前進，必須沿路找地方幫歐兜邁充車有時靠著知名度順利借到電，有時地點偏僻千辛萬苦才借到電，得以一路往前，因此創造了溫暖回憶旅途中伴騎的伙伴會不斷更換，出川也不忘搞笑，和伙伴一搭一唱讓你忍不住捧腹大笑

programme.title: Matsuko不知道的世界:75
programme.desc: 以豪邁的作風與犀利的評論，讓觀眾喜愛不已的貴婦松子所主持的談話節目，每期討論的主題包羅萬象，從美食類的抹茶甜點在地沾醬咖哩麵包，到其他類型的鍵盤點活世界，以及交友軟體等，並由對該領域極度著迷的專家進行介紹，一起揭開這令人驚奇，且不為人知的世界！

programme.title: 台灣好吃驚之高志部長趴趴走:5
programme.desc: 國興衛視自製新形態生活風格節目-台灣好吃驚精華內容，由日本演員松野高志主持，介紹台日文化大不同! 在台灣司空見慣的事,在日本人的眼裡看起來又是如何呢? 集結台灣好吃驚各種精華，由好吃驚部長-高志再次深入台灣各地,發掘台灣讓日本人驚奇的各種新鮮事以及文化美食,藉由高志部長與小夥伴們的挖掘,還會發現連台灣人也嘖嘖稱奇的事蹟!

programme.desc: 風月同天此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫共度風雨影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影以行動，讓愛無國界這，就是慈濟一個由無數人的小善匯聚成世界之光的故事

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場
programme.desc: 1945年，村岡花子邊看原文小說，邊翻查著字典，將譯文撰寫於稿紙上這一年她已經52歲，正在進行小說Anne of Green Gables的翻譯工作此時正值二次大戰末期，節節敗退的日本正遭受盟軍轟炸機的密集轟炸，因此花子在工作時，還得隨時注意外頭的狀況，若發布空襲警報，就得帶著女兒到防空洞避難每當避難時，她手上必定帶著書本及譯稿，對花子來說，這是比她的生命還重要的東西這天她一如往常的進行翻譯工作，她突然停下了筆，開始回想她這一生的經歷，花子與安妮的故事就此展開

programme.title: 臥底-頭號通緝

programme.title: 重返侏羅紀
programme.desc: 面對遠古生物無情攻擊，他們設法死裡逃生為了研發抗癌藥物，正仁醫藥集團四處招兵買馬，試圖尋找傳說中的遠古植物-火獄蔓蓮當探險隊在孤島尋找時，他們突然遭到迅猛龍包圍攻擊，全數罹難身亡消息一傳回集團，為了替哥哥復仇，江海決定帶領探險隊再次前往而這時，為了早日治癒身上癌症，集團董事長陳正仁也決定隨行前往，行前他先至醫院，設法說服女兒接受化療的考古學家薛文中，表示此舉不僅可以讓他親眼目睹活化石，平反當年誤判，更可因此拯救飽受病痛折磨的女兒

programme.title: 致命羅密歐

programme.title: 天外封鎖線

programme.title: 飢惡河馬

programme.title: 致命追緝令

programme.title: 功夫

programme.desc: 他們將用生命與速度，一決勝負！玩世不恭的詹姆士與處事有序的尼基是技術高超的賽車手，來自英國的詹姆士，帥氣卻花心，每次賽前都會嘔吐；而與家族談判贊助賽車破裂的尼基，則是奧地利的機械天才，兩人的生活與人生天差地別，但勝利沒有捷徑，只要一不留神，就可能會失去所有

programme.title: 致命羅密歐
programme.desc: 黑幫衝突撕裂城市，唯有功夫皇帝李連杰，才能終結混亂！前香港警探韓星得知弟弟在美國遇害，冒險越獄前往奧克蘭調查他意外結識了敵對黑幫千金翠茜，兩人因此身陷華人黑幫與非裔幫派的領地爭奪戰在聯手追查真相的過程中，他們不僅要面對幫派間的血腥衝突，更揭發了家族內部出賣親人的驚人陰謀與背叛

programme.title: 悍將女廚
programme.desc: 他們婚姻隱藏秘密，而秘密包藏著致命危機一對老夫少妻經營一家知名餐廳，而妻子安娜是饕客滿座的名廚，然而，她的婚姻裡隱藏著一個不為人知的秘密，直到某晚，一群殺人不眨眼的殺手齊聚於她的餐廳，企圖摧毀她的餐廳，如今，她將如何捍衛她的廚房，施展她不為人知的另一面呢？！

programme.title: 功夫
programme.desc: 自小受盡欺辱的街頭小混混阿星，最厲害的就是能言善道，一心想成就大業的他，這次謊稱自己是日益猖獗的斧頭幫，前往豬籠城寨勒索敲詐，卻不知豬籠城寨裡個個臥虎藏龍，不服輸的他，假裝點砲火求救兵，卻意外引來正牌的斧頭幫與當地居民的恩怨面對斧頭幫惡霸，豬籠城寨身手不凡的高手們將如何應戰呢？！

programme.title: 樂活新觀點

programme.title: 致命追緝令
programme.desc: 莉比帕森原本生活美滿，她有一個英俊富有的丈夫，一個備受兩人疼愛的獨子，再西雅圖近郊有一棟美麗的豪宅，及一群好友當她的丈夫因為一個浪漫的週末出海未歸後，她竟被控謀殺，使得她美好的生活頓時轉為惡夢

programme.title: 玩命快遞
programme.desc: 曾是特種部隊的法蘭克，自營快遞工作，並堅持三不鐵則：不改交易不問姓名不看包裹對他來說，破壞規矩，就是玩命的開始這時，他接獲最新指令，替人運送一個約50公斤的包裹，在運送過程中，他發現他的包裹會動，好奇心驅使下，他打破了第三條規矩，發現包裹裡面竟然是一個被五花大綁的東方女子

programme.title: 最後防線
programme.desc: 菲爾布洛克是退休的緝毒局探員，也是個愛家男人，他決定離開塵囂跟女兒搬到一處看似寧靜的河灣鄉間，逃離紛亂的過去然而，他的生活很快就變得不平靜，因為他發現這個小鎮潛藏著毒品和暴力的危機不久，橫行霸道的毒梟大王嘉托伯汀脅迫要傷害布洛克和他女兒，為了拯救他家人和這個小鎮，他只能重出江湖

programme.title: 毀滅大作戰
programme.desc: 昔日摯友瞬間變成摧毀世界的狂暴巨獸，地表最強巨獸空前集結！一場失控的太空基因實驗墜落地球，引爆全球末日浩劫！溫馴的白化症猩猩野狼與鱷魚意外接觸變異催化劑，體型瘋狂暴增至高樓等級，且刀槍不入，將繁華的芝加哥城瞬間變成殘酷的巨獸遊樂場為了喚醒摯友白化症猩猩心中殘存的人性，巨石強森火力全開，賭上性命！

programme.title: 小書痴的下剋上 1-3季
programme.desc: 從小就是個超級書痴的女大學生麗乃，愛書愛到希望在書堆裡死去該說是夢想成真嗎？好不容易應徵上圖書館工作的她，卻在地震時被掉落的書給活埋當她再度醒過來，發現自己竟然轉生到了陌生的異世界，變成名叫梅茵的五歲小女孩，不但生在貧窮的士兵家，而且還體弱多病，但最讓她難以接受的是，這個世界完全找不到任何書店或圖書館，就算想看書，也是一般平民根本買不起的天價！於是梅茵下定決心：既然買不到書，那我就自己動手做！憑藉著對書的滿腔熱情，目標是成為圖書管理員為了在異世界也能過著被書環繞的美好生活，就從做書開始努力吧！

programme.desc: 以親子露營的方式，實鏡紀錄孩子與爸爸的互動以及如何適應環境,挑戰任務，讓小朋友們親近大自然並與爸爸一起進入部落共同學習傳統文化，用祖先流傳的智慧方式學習生活

programme.title: 越來越嗖鯊
programme.desc: 越來越嗖鯊！（Xu?t s?c）是公視兒少新住民語言學習節目--越南系列嗖鯊是越南語Xu?t s?c的諧音，也是厲害出色的意思收視觀眾由原本6-12歲的學齡兒童，擴大至家長老師以致於全民節目方向已不只為了要新二代學媽媽的語言，而是要認識台灣多數人的語言主持人-阮秋姮節目中扮演嗖鯊甜點坊老闆，其開朗熱心又有點調皮的個性，成為來店大小顧客解決問題的聊天對象，其和店員嗖鯊哥及來賓，產生有趣的互動，進而瞭解越南語言及文化

programme.title: 歡迎光臨我的牧場2
programme.desc: 歡迎光臨我的牧場第二季全新集數，從兒童視角探索台灣牧場與動物科普這一次，我們不只認識動物，更跟著小主人一起生活面對害怕失敗與意想不到的狀況，孩子也在一次次嘗試中，找到自己和動物相處的方式

programme.title: 小書痴的下剋上 1-3季
programme.desc: 從小就是個超級書痴的女大學生麗乃，愛書愛到希望在書堆裡死去該說是夢想成真嗎？好不容易應徵上圖書館工作的她，卻在地震時被掉落的書給活埋當她再度醒過來，發現自己竟然轉生到了陌生的異世界，變成名叫梅茵的五歲小女孩，不但生在貧窮的士兵家，而且還體弱多病，但最讓她難以接受的是，這個世界完全找不到任何書店或圖書館，就算想看書，也是一般平民根本買不起的天價！於是梅茵下定決心：既然買不到書，那我就自己動手做！憑藉著對書的滿腔熱情，目標是成為圖書管理員為了在異世界也能過著被書環繞的美好生活，就從做書開始努力吧！

programme.title: 反正你也不睡覺
programme.desc: 每週兩天，在線上跟你說一個故事，可能是一本小說一封陌生人的來信，或邀請大來賓到現場

programme.title: 我們的島
programme.desc: 台灣是個四面環海的小島，島上發生的大小事件都和我們息息相關，不論是關於岸邊溼地海裡飛魚每年過境的候鳥近年發展有成的有機農業，還是將塑膠回收再利用等議題，都是這個結合新聞性和知識性的節目要探討的重要話題，是所有關心台灣社會與生態的民眾都應該收看的優良電視節目

programme.title: 浩克慢遊
programme.desc: 天很藍，世界很大我揹上背包，迎著陽光，享受寧靜五月，稻田由翠青轉為墨綠眼前的這熟悉景致，許久以來，和我們的生活緊密相連農人穿梭田中，白黃色汗衫在大片的綠中，格外明顯上學的小學生急忙跑過旁邊的小徑，差點撞上沾滿泥土的老野狼再仔細觀看，雲的流動，讓陽光在田中染上不同層次的綠，稻浪不規則的轉換樹枝的擺動落葉的方向，讓我看見風心要夠靜，旅行的況味才得以擴展開來童年的旅行叫遠足，關注的是書包得裝滿平日難得吃到的零食，至於去哪裡倒不是那麼重要年輕時的旅行，拚的是疾走的氣勢，一路騎車到墾丁，早上吃完包子，還可以在沙灘上奔跑一整天現在的旅行，我會放慢腳步，聆聽不期而遇的滿滿人情台灣的美，絕對處處充滿驚喜

programme.desc: 越來越嗖鯊！（Xu?t s?c）是公視兒少新住民語言學習節目--越南系列嗖鯊是越南語Xu?t s?c的諧音，也是厲害出色的意思收視觀眾由原本6-12歲的學齡兒童，擴大至家長老師以致於全民節目方向已不只為了要新二代學媽媽的語言，而是要認識台灣多數人的語言主持人-阮秋姮節目中扮演嗖鯊甜點坊老闆，其開朗熱心又有點調皮的個性，成為來店大小顧客解決問題的聊天對象，其和店員嗖鯊哥及來賓，產生有趣的互動，進而瞭解越南語言及文化

programme.title: 下課花路米-全球暖化系列
programme.desc: 12位關心全球暖化現象的大人小孩，將兵分三路前往北極帛琉挪威三地，在暖化最前線，一探氣候變遷的真相

programme.title: 歡迎光臨我的牧場2
programme.desc: 歡迎光臨我的牧場第二季全新集數，從兒童視角探索台灣牧場與動物科普這一次，我們不只認識動物，更跟著小主人一起生活面對害怕失敗與意想不到的狀況，孩子也在一次次嘗試中，找到自己和動物相處的方式

programme.title: 月球歷險記
programme.desc: 有時候聽妹妹的話會比較保險！身為太空迷彼德在某個夜晚發現妹妹不見了，他才突然意識到妹妹之前瘋狂談論的會說話的六月金龜子樹樹蟲並不是虛構的於是，彼德踏上了月球之旅，要將妹妹從大壞蛋月人手中拯救出來旅途中他遇到了許多自然界的神靈，也才發現自己一直忽視了妹妹

programme.title: 成仁高中偵探社
programme.desc: 成仁高中偵探社是2024年小公視專門為青少年打造的大型沉浸式實境闖關解謎節目，以學校為場域，社員需逐一破解謎題關卡，找到委託案件的真相每集案件結合戲劇元素，直擊當今青少年面對的校園黑暗面，讓觀眾在推理解謎的樂趣之外，也能反思霸凌權勢性騷擾校園簽賭等重要的青少年議題

programme.desc: 餐廳的主廚路邊推攤的小車媽媽桌上的菜餚東西料理異國風情時尚美味精緻饗宴...，台灣文化融合了外來移民的多樣性，四百年來五味雜陳，用味道記錄在地故事用感動記憶美食溫度酸甜苦辣五味人生台灣壹百種味道

programme.title: 百變智多星:288
programme.desc: 韓星代表專門戶梁赫群，益智鬼靈精傻妞葉欣眉，兩人合作無間智多星主題短劇爆笑開場超直白訪談笑料不斷字助猜體驗文學之美知識淘汰郎刺激中長智慧決戰168誰能闖關成功拿十萬

programme.title: 師聲對決
programme.desc: 一心想當律師的內拉是阿爾及利亞裔法國人，如願考上巴黎第二大學法律系的她卻在開學第一天遲到態度輕浮，被超難搞的教授皮耶用言語修理一番，同學更煽動內拉以種族歧視反擊兩人唇槍舌戰的事件傳開，校方只能說服皮耶訓練內拉參加辯論大賽，證明皮耶並非種族歧視者，互看不順眼的兩人就此精彩對決！

programme.title: 台灣壹百種味道第1季:93
programme.desc: 台灣壹百種味道以臺灣味為主角，透過節目，呈現每一道臺灣菜的滋味與廚師的故事 藉由一道道美食，看見每一位美食作手，背後所潛藏的人生故事 觀眾跟著故事了解臺灣美食歷史

programme.title: 健康好自在
programme.desc: 每集邀請來賓分享保養秘方，若沒有天生麗質，就只有靠後天努力，專門為女性所設計的健康節目

programme.title: 白色城堡:1
programme.desc: 王揚鳴，一位剛畢業的博士生，踏上安康醫院面試之旅早晨為了準備，他與外甥遭遇尷尬場面，姐姐的勉勵支持了他然而，面試現場競爭激烈，學歷壓力重重，他展現自信和身體優勢...

programme.title: 健康好生活:2052
programme.desc: 健康好生活從最基本的健康飲食著手，詳細探討人體所需之各大營養素，運用時令的當季食材，做出營養均衡又美味的家常料理！而在節目中的台灣各專科百大名醫，則是透過分享在醫療工作上的實際案例，說明各種疾病的症狀與預防的重要性！

programme.title: Linking 368 Taiwan恁去台灣:35
programme.desc: Linking 368 Taiwan恁去台灣，走訪全台368個行政區，雙語播出志在走出台灣邁向國際，讓世界看見台灣

programme.title: 那些年那些歌:241
programme.desc: 隨音樂創作人陳國華，找回音樂最初的悸動！一段旋律承載一段記憶，一首歌曲紀錄一段歲月分享好歌，走進生命中感動的回憶，世代衝擊，震撼熱愛創作的音樂魂！

programme.desc: 淮陽王崔行舟（張晚意 飾）年少有為，一生以剿滅仰山匪徒為己任柳眠棠（王楚然 飾）為仰山女寨主，帶領仰山眾人懲惡揚善某日，行舟救下受重傷失憶的眠棠，豈料她醒來後竟將行舟誤認為夫君崔九，行舟則誤以為眠棠是仰山頭領的寵妾，便將計就計假扮她的夫君探消息，想誘敵現身眠棠跟隨行舟守護邊關，兩人從客氣相處，進一步發展成兩情相悅，無奈身份被識破，感情又將面臨考驗?

programme.title: 主君的太陽
programme.desc: 個性樂觀如太陽的女子太恭實（孔曉振 飾），因發生事故後，成為可以看見鬼魂的人，她每天被鬼魂騷擾並生活在驚恐之中，使得她生活日夜顛倒精神不濟某日，恭實遇到個性高傲的購物中心社長朱中元（蘇志燮 飾），她不小心碰觸到中元的身體，沒想到這些騷擾她的鬼神竟立刻煙消雲散！那次之後，恭實決定巴著中元不放，並且把他當成自己的防空洞，兩人之間的不解之緣及愛情故事就此展開?

programme.title: 背著善宰跑
programme.desc: 柳善宰（邊佑錫 飾），Eclipse樂團主唱，外貌實力兼具的韓國頂流明星，看似風光的人生卻承受著許多壓力在他19歲的時候，其實最愛的是游泳，而且還有一位暗戀的女孩任率（金惠奫 飾），15年前因為一場意外終生不良於行，喪失求生意志的她，因為善宰的歌曲有了堅持下去的勇氣，決定振作並成為他的鐵粉新聞傳來善宰死亡的消息，小率卻神奇地回到高中發生意外前，那時她的雙腿不但行動自如，更遇上高中時期的善宰，她能改變過去，為兩人創造不一樣的未來嗎？

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 雞不可失
programme.desc: 一支由5位掉漆警探組成的緝毒小組，因辦事不力被長官釘得滿頭包，成天埋伏在毒販巢穴對面的炸雞店中監視，案情也毫無進展既然每天都得待在炸雞店，不如動手賣起炸雞，看似無厘頭的決定，竟讓魯蛇警探們意外找到事業第二春，賣到嚇嚇叫的神級美味炸雞，讓餐廳一夕爆紅，訂單電話接到手軟！副業做太大的警探們有辦法達成使命嗎？對面的毒販又是否會聞香而來呢？

programme.title: 最初的晚餐
programme.desc: 麟太郎（染谷將太 飾）和姐姐美也子（戶田惠梨香 飾）?了父親（永瀨正敏 飾）的葬禮返回家鄉，在守靈夜開始之前，母親秋子卻（齊藤由貴 飾）取消了所有的餐點並親自下廚隨著秋子端出一道道熟悉的料理，全家人回想起20年前，新媽媽秋子帶著大哥哥舜（窪塚洋介 飾）加入後五人一起生活的點滴，無論是曾經一起出遊的快樂回憶或是為了習慣差異出現的種種摩擦，不僅讓麟太郎他們重新思考家人的定義，更想起15年前，哥哥舜在一夜之間離家後再也沒回家的往事

programme.title: 戰略陰謀-失控任務
programme.desc: 聯邦特務捲入複雜人口販賣組織機構，中央情報局新秀狙擊手布蘭登貝克特與他的前盟友國土安全局特務席羅和刺客死亡夫人攜手揭開這個特務的貪汙真面目，並摧毀犯罪組織

programme.title: 雙面特務
programme.desc: 在這裡，說謊是人們的第二天性 故事發生在21世紀初，國際情勢爾虞我詐，戰爭隨時一觸即發瑞秋（黛安克魯格 飾）因為優異的天分及語言能力，被以色列特務組織相中，送往伊朗進行臥底，佯裝成無害的英文老師，接近神秘的目標法哈德（凱斯安凡 飾），以了解更多核武計畫的內容然而，就在任務即將宣告終結的關鍵時刻，瑞秋卻離奇失蹤了，除了一通打給搭檔湯瑪士（馬丁費里曼 飾）的神秘電話，什麼也沒留下湯瑪士必須想盡辦法找出瑞秋的下落，還要設法保護組織甚至國家的安全不受到牽連

programme.title: 地獄
programme.desc: 哈佛大學符號學教授羅柏蘭登教授從一間醫院的病床上醒來，對過去幾天發生的事情完全失去記憶，他發現自己身處義大利佛羅倫斯，身旁的醫生席耶娜告訴他，他曾受過槍擊？這次蘭登教授將深入義大利佛羅倫斯，在百花大教堂維奇奧宮等古蹟間追查波提伽利地獄圖所引發的種種謎團，在環環相扣的線索間，蘭登教授竟發現這是一場生化危機！？

programme.title: 寶貝計劃
programme.desc: 講述三名慣偷不爽的竊賊為一時貪念而偷走了一個身價高貴的可愛寶貝，卻因為寶貝的出現使他們各自的生活改善，引發了不少笑料的故事...

programme.title: 哥吉拉大戰金剛
programme.desc: 兩位神級巨獸展開史詩般的殊死一戰，當傳奇正面對決時，世界的命運危在旦夕金剛與牠的保護者，踏上危險的旅程，尋找牠真正的家園，同行的還有吉雅這名年輕的小孤女，與金剛間有著獨特且強大的聯繫但他們意外地與憤怒的哥吉拉狹路相逢，並在全球引發一場腥風血雨...

programme.title: 私刑教育3
programme.desc: 自從退休之後，勞勃麥考仍舊無法忘記他當年當政府殺手時所做的一切，並且透過逞罰惡勢力的作法，獲得心靈上的慰藉這次當他以為在義大利南部找到歸屬時，發現他的新朋友受到當地黑手黨的威脅，因此決定重拾舊業解救大家

programme.title: 300壯士-帝國崛起
programme.desc: 故事開始於自命為神王的薛西斯大帝，他雖然在溫泉關戰役打敗了斯巴達國王雷奧尼達，臉上卻被雷奧尼達留下一道深深的傷口，而斯巴達300壯士的勇猛，也深深撼動了波斯帝國數十萬大軍又驚又怒的薛西斯大帝除了繼續將大軍開往希臘之外，海上也派出上千艘的戰艦，兩面夾擊希臘城邦帝米斯托克力將軍蘇利文斯坦布萊頓飾演在波斯大軍壓境下誓言保衛希臘，他親率希臘船隊，嚴陣以待數千艘波斯戰艦的不斷進逼，波斯的龐大艦隊則是由一心要對希臘報仇的女將軍雅特米希亞伊娃葛林飾演領軍，兩大軍事奇才海上交鋒，一場史上罕見的殘酷戰爭即將血染整片海洋

programme.title: 珍愛硬起來
programme.desc: 由珍妮佛勞倫斯飾演的麥蒂，為了保住她從小長大的房子，找到一則耐人尋味的徵人啟事一對有錢的恐龍家長，希望能在內向的兒子波西上大學前，找到人來與他約會出乎意料之外，麥蒂發現令人尷尬的波西，其實不是那麼簡單就能搞定的

programme.title: 鬼劍奇兵
programme.desc: 渴望成為最強動作女明星的妍熙（安智慧 飾），意外進到了以劍術實力左右性命的奇妙平行世界妍熙在這個世界中為了正義而努力擊退不良分子，某天，真正的鬼劍登場，發生了一連串的事件握在手上的這把劍，竟喚醒自己真實的身分！？

programme.title: 紅鷹戰士-天空的守護者
programme.desc: 在遠古時代，雄偉的迦樓羅族與冷酷殘暴的羅剎巨魔之間爆發了激烈戰爭迦樓羅族在戰鬥中節節敗退，面臨滅族危機為了阻止羅剎巨魔征服世界的野心，最後的迦樓羅戰士與英勇的希姆馬潘戰士結盟，展開一場關乎世界命運的終極對決

programme.title: GT-跨界玩家

programme.title: 人生一串第1季
programme.desc: 少了點煙火氣，人生就像是一場孤獨的旅程從雲南昭通一口一串的牛肉小串塔克拉瑪干沙漠裡用紅柳枝串起的霸氣烤羊肉，再到廣西百色讓人既害怕又想試的炭烤豬眼睛夜市與街角邊的燒烤攤遍佈各地，每一攤都有自己獨門的在地風味節目用鏡頭穿梭在街頭巷尾，記錄下最平民的在地美食與夜市傳奇，以最貼近生活的視角，真實呈現那一串串燒烤背後的人情味與故事在享受每一串燒烤帶來的極致美味時，也帶大家一起品味最真實最接地氣的人生滋味

programme.title: 角頭-浪流連
programme.desc: 故事描述阿慶（鄭人碩 飾演）在北館角頭大哥 仁哥的女兒滿月宴上，偶遇攝影師小淇（謝欣穎 飾演）進而衍生出一段相愛卻不能相守的愛情故事 身為角頭的阿慶遇到了小淇，原本水火不容的兩人，再一次次的爭吵中發現其實自己最在乎對方阿慶與小淇相愛相知相惜互相扶持，阿慶為小淇解決困難小淇在阿慶事業遇到瓶頸時給予鼓勵但就在此時湳沆的世界在背地裡陷害北館販毒，不僅讓北館深陷危機，仁哥與五虎們相繼誤解阿慶，小淇也因為阿慶受重傷阿慶分身乏術，痛定思痛決定奮力一搏

programme.title: 唐人街探案3
programme.desc: 繼曼谷紐約之後，東京再出大案唐人街神探唐仁（王寶強 飾）秦風（劉昊然 飾）受偵探野田昊（妻夫木聰 飾）邀請前往破案CRIMASTER世界偵探排行榜中的偵探們聞訊也前往東京，加入挑戰，而排名第一Q的現身，讓這個大案更加撲朔迷離，一場亞洲最強神探之間的較量即將爆笑展開

programme.title: 捉妖記
programme.desc: 某天，一對神祕夫婦與懷有小妖王的妖后逃到永寧村，遇上了善良的天蔭以及降妖少女小嵐，天蔭更陰差陽錯下成為代理孕夫誕下小妖王胡巴葛千戶重金懸賞小妖王小嵐為了得到賞金，拉著天蔭展開了一段奇幻旅程可愛的小妖王胡巴出生，令天蔭和小嵐關係起了奇妙變化，同時也揭發了一個重大祕密

programme.title: 翻供
programme.desc: 獲得百想藝術大獎最佳新人男演員 入圍青龍電影獎最佳女配角 從小因父親重男輕女，貞仁（申惠善 飾演）在中學時就逃家自力更生，與家人斷了聯繫貞仁後來憑一己之力成為頂級辯護律師，在一次偶然中，她得知罹患失智症的母親花子（裴宗玉 飾演）涉嫌殺害父親，同時還對不少無辜民眾下毒手 懷疑事有蹊翹的貞仁決定親自出馬，在層層阻撓下，她該如何為母親翻供，揭開這個樁謀殺案背後不可告人的真相？

programme.title: 通天神探狄仁傑
programme.desc: 西元690年，武則天劉嘉玲飾 即將登基，成為中國第一位女皇帝象徵至高皇權的通天浮屠接近完工，路人皆知浮屠落成之日，女皇登基之時此時洛陽發生幾起命案，死者無故自燃，都在胸腹間起火，延及全身，宛若炮烙般被燒成灰燼，都是武則天的親信！

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-零的執行人
programme.desc: 首度被作為爆炸嫌疑犯而遭逮捕的毛利小五郎，毛利蘭與柯南如何搶救？！ 東京灣最新而宏偉的建築Edge of Ocean即將在5月1日舉辦國際高峰會，國內外政商聚集，兩萬兩千名警力高度戒備，不料卻遭人暗中潛伏，策動了一場巨大爆炸事故！

programme.title: 天降神機
programme.desc: 黃星徹，18歲，幼時跟隨祖父母住在沿海一帶，直到國中才搬回與父母同住，期待著一個陌生又溫馨的家庭關係，然而好景不常，家中因父親賭債開始四處躲藏，母親也在償還債務後毅然決然離去，阿徹看在眼裡對母親沒有怨恨反倒徒留不捨，然而對以酒洗面的父親極度埋怨，兩人相處充滿在仇恨與怨懟之中，因父親在工地打臨時工與警察二叔的投靠，阿徹也在不停轉換學校與環境的過程，養成自力更生的能力，但一切轉換的不適與父親的關係等無處發洩，藉由打架與不良學生的標籤得以找到暫時的存在感

programme.title: 新封神榜-楊戩
programme.desc: 取材自經典神話封神演義，從楊戩被迫封印天眼神通，法力大減開始，他轉而成為一位賞金獵人，然而一名神秘女子婉羅找上楊戩，委託他去追捕一名叫沉香的少年，並尋回法力無邊的寶蓮燈沉香企圖用寶蓮燈的法力劈開華山，拯救被壓在蓮花峰下的母親卻不知此舉將會放出被鎮壓在其中的滅世玄鳥，為天下蒼生帶來毀天滅地的災禍而楊戩為了阻止沉香，意外揭開一樁塵封已久的秘密

programme.title: 乒乓男孩
programme.desc: 熱愛桌球的胡冠宇和好友黃軒夢想成為全世界最強的雙打組合，儘管學校社團資源有限，他們仍樂在其中，為夢想努力不懈直到一次雙打比賽落敗黃軒被嚴厲的母親要求轉學，兩人帶著心結分道揚鑣一年後的國手選拔賽上他們在球桌兩端相遇；即將一決勝負，面對自己最有默契的搭檔，誰能脫穎而出成為選手？

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之怒海雄風
programme.desc: 甲午戰敗，喪權辱國的馬關條約簽訂後，日本又想武力強佔東沙群島，進而吞併西沙群島南沙群島軍機大臣張之洞堅決主戰，並前往廣州整軍備戰於是以服部一郎川島雪姬為首的日本殺手秘密組織神奈社，買通白蓮教，抓走張之洞大人黃飛鴻和他的徒弟們以身犯險查詢線索開始了營救張之洞之路，慢慢揭開了日本人的陰謀

programme.desc: 一名 52 歲的醫療中心副總裁，因致命刺殺一名醫生的丈夫而面臨 95 年監禁他聲稱對方有意加害，自己為自保才動手

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:157
programme.desc: 觀察最瘋狂的法庭時刻一名逃犯出現在法院但又改變心意，逃離警方；遭到襲擊的受害者在法庭面對她的攻擊者等

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:158
programme.desc: 觀察最瘋狂的法庭時刻遭指控的殺人犯逃離法院；一名青少年因搶劫販賣女童軍餅乾的9歲孩童而受到審判等

programme.title: 阿拉斯加州警第9季:3
programme.desc: 在阿拉斯加一個瘋狂的夏日裡，州警找到一名全裸的獵狼男子，在森林中追蹤一名重罪嫌犯，並前往北極圈以北的偏遠村莊處理囤積動物案件

programme.title: 汽車旅館命案第1季:5
programme.desc: 2006 年 8 月 29 日，加州河濱縣河濱縣警長部門的警員接報，前往嘉維蘭丘陵偏遠地區，調查一輛遭棄置的車輛，卻意外揭開一宗駭人的命案

programme.title: 偵訊實境第2季:16

programme.title: 死因解謎:9

programme.title: 衝鋒警犬第1季:12

programme.title: 偵訊現場:4

programme.title: 刑偵日記:22
programme.desc: 多年前，楊碧芯因精神分裂險些毒殺兒子葉勁峰與女兒葉朗晴勁峰遭逢巨變解離出體弱但高智的人格朱璣，朱璣苦讀成筆跡專家，助身手不凡的勁峰執行臥底任務雙重炸彈案血字裸屍案促總督察江政勳集合勁峰精神科醫生韋睿傑拆彈警花游雁星法醫人類學家方菀芊組成特案組緝兇，竟譜出四人五角戀！

programme.title: 新聞女王2:19
programme.desc: 文慧心離開 SNK 後加入劉艷的公開平台，在新媒體領域續寫新聞女王傳奇，令 SNK 新總監古肇華備感威脅而升任副總監卻備受掣肘的張家妍，毅然跳槽新機構，與 SNK公開平台形成三足鼎立之勢此時，身居政府新聞處要職的許詩晴成了各方爭奪的關鍵在這場傳統電視網絡新聞與自媒體交織的無硝煙戰場上，這群新聞人將再次為爭奪主導權展開激烈交鋒

programme.title: 黃金萬両:4
programme.desc: 萬家拉麵傳人萬帥（曹永廉飾）萬年（黃子恆飾）萬世（馬貫東飾）在一街上各自經營自家麵店，造成惡性競爭，龍九（麥美恩飾）霍小玉（朱智賢飾）及金枝（江嘉敏飾）妯娌之間也鬥氣不斷，身為一家之主的萬紫千紅（薛家燕飾）在先夫入夢後心生一計，在年三十帶回神秘木箱，?人推斷木箱內藏著皇上御賜的金大碗，對木箱虎視眈眈，千紅遂決定在新年年初一至七期間，遵行各種過年習俗和傳統，觀察各房表現來決定金大碗花落誰家

programme.title: 金宵大廈2:17

programme.title: 神鵰俠侶:32
programme.desc: 楊過（古天樂）一次誤闖活死人墓中，拜得古墓派掌門小龍女（李若彤）為師二人相依為命，在不自覺中萌生了微妙的男女感情，且到達生死相連之境！二人對此情堅貞不渝，縱龍被尹志平（陳啟泰）所辱，仍能摒除世俗眼光而當眾成親！後二人相分，十六年後終在絕情谷再續情緣 另一廂，郭靖（白彪）黃蓉（魏秋樺）將女兒郭芙（傅明憲）許配予過，但為過所拒絕自始芙與過積怨日深，一次誤會中，芙更斬下過之左手！而小東邪郭襄（李綺虹）對過豁達情深，更鼓勵過踏遍天涯海角去覓回龍

programme.title: 她她她的少女時代:9
programme.desc: 人到中年，營役半生，方迎風的人生卻迎來遽變！失婚失業，女兒離巢，她迷失她頑抗，卻體力衰退與社會脫節身為別人的女兒老婆老媽，她卻忘了少女時代，也曾是個熱血勇悍瘋狂追星的搖滾樂迷！二十年前的輕狂歲月，二十年後的柴米油鹽，面目全非的她，竟重遇當年迷戀的偶像！偶像潦倒不堪，丈夫欲斷難斷，種種挫折與衝擊，迫使她直面過去的失敗，重新振作，激勵自己與身邊人唱著一首首動人歌曲，一群失意的中年男女，再次出發，為了自己，再活一次！

programme.title: 大醬園:7
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山與夫人席德容堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿及葉細么兩女加入，與其子萬卓楓成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石啟川及啟江醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！

programme.desc: 人到中年，營役半生，方迎風的人生卻迎來遽變！失婚失業，女兒離巢，她迷失她頑抗，卻體力衰退與社會脫節身為別人的女兒老婆老媽，她卻忘了少女時代，也曾是個熱血勇悍瘋狂追星的搖滾樂迷！二十年前的輕狂歲月，二十年後的柴米油鹽，面目全非的她，竟重遇當年迷戀的偶像！偶像潦倒不堪，丈夫欲斷難斷，種種挫折與衝擊，迫使她直面過去的失敗，重新振作，激勵自己與身邊人唱著一首首動人歌曲，一群失意的中年男女，再次出發，為了自己，再活一次！

programme.title: 大醬園:9

programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在无微不至的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的美满婚姻中挣脱出来而在找回自我尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的战斗就此打响.

programme.title: 香港探秘地图 The Map Of Truth

programme.title: 味解鄉愁 Wei Jie Xiang Chou

programme.title: 戀戀不忘的我們 Lets Talk About Love

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2022 S13 Perfect Match 2022

programme.title: 一站到底 少年季 第2季 Whos Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2

Edora cemburu apabila tahu Taufik menemani Ana dalam sesi jelajahnya ke Ipoh. Taufik pula cemburu melihat respon Ana setiap kali menerima mesej atau panggilan dari Johan dan pura-pura berbual mesra dengan Edora. Ana yang tidak sedar dia juga cemburu, menerima pelawaan seorang VIP untuk keluar dengannya.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ketika Izz dan Dara merancang bulan madu, Ryan menipu Dara dengan mendakwa dirinya menghidap tumor otak demi menagih simpati. programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING CHEUNG KA FAI and the loafer, JIAN, CHIN KA LOK always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIANs teacher, SUN LIU KAI CHI to death. They even make the banker, HUNG LAW LOK LAUs business bankrupted and HUNGs daughter, PO, CHEUNG YUK SHAN has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN HSUAN JESSICA HESTERs female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent The First Tooth. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agents reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHINGs talent together with JIAN and LUNs assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as The Virgin Courtesan, The Twins and The Nice Weather etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel Whats On Today
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: War Of Thorns Whats On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Our Theme Songs
programme.desc: TVB has created countless beloved classic dramas and pioneered a golden age of Cantonese drama theme songs. To celebrate its 55th anniversary, TVB presents the singing program Our Theme Songs, featuring classic drama songs that you can listen to again and again. Each episode has a specific drama theme, guiding viewers into the world of television theme songs. It also invites the original singers of once-popular songs, along with other celebrity guests, to lend their voices. These classic songs have been re-arranged and given new life, allowing everyone to appreciate and experience the extraordinary charm of these drama hits!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Shaw Prize Special 2026, The
programme.desc: The 2026 Shaw Prize in Life Sciences and Medicine will be awarded equally to Anne Deschamps, Dai Yuge, and Chen Zhu for their discovery of the molecular and cellular pathogenic basis of acute promyelocytic leukemia and for pioneering synergistic targeted therapy, which has transformed this disease from one of the deadliest cancers to one of the most curable cancers, with a cure rate of over 90.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: The Le Grand Tour de Seoul is on its way again, with Samantha Ko, Kalok Chow, and Brian Chu set off to enjoy a fantastic stay in Seoul! The hosts will visit local Michelin-starred restaurants and savor top-quality Korean beef. Beyond the culinary adventure, the two male hosts will also have the opportunity to work out with Korean star and fitness icon Kim Jong-kook, followed by a delicious barbecue. The three will also enjoy personalized activities: Samantha will have a romantic date with a ceramic artist Brian Chu will experience bespoke tailoring, showcasing his impeccable style and Kalok will try on a styling session inspired by a top Korean celebrity, undergoing a glamorous makeover. This exclusive and enjoyable experience will lead viewers to the ultimate in Seouls luxurious charm!

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Hong Kong possesses a unique urban character, where old and new coexist, and its diverse cultures blend seamlessly, creating a series of captivating scenes under the interplay of light and shadow! Hosts Chris Lai and Winki Lai guide viewers through different movie locations, revisiting classic scenes and memorable quotes, evoking touching memories. Follow the programs carefully selected routes to admire the dazzling cityscape and immerse yourself in the world of cinema. The hosts will also demonstrate photo-taking techniques, teaching viewers how to capture the unique charm of this City of Light and Shadow with their cameras. In addition, film actors revisit filming locations, reminiscing about their past shoots action directors share their insights on designing action scenes, showcasing the allure of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: Super Love Beauty
programme.desc: Super Love Beauty is a lively beauty and lifestyle programme hosted by Genie Chuo and Emmie Ries. It turns makeup, skincare and fashion trends into practical, easy-to-follow ideas, helping viewers refresh their daily routines and discover confident personal style.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers fast-paced coverage of the latest celebrity news, entertainment events and popular culture. Through studio segments, interviews, live reports and highlights, the programme keeps viewers informed about current stars, performances and industry developments.

programme.title: Love Around
programme.desc: After painful breakups, Zhou Zhen and radio DJ Liang Xiaoshu find comfort in each other. Their growing bond is tested when his father responds to her criticism by deciding to buy her radio station, leaving Zhou caught between family and love.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: On its maiden flight, an A380 airliner is hijacked by armed gunmen. Among the passengers is international security expert Gao Hao Jun, whose daughter has been taken hostage, putting her life in grave danger. Determined to save her, Gao confronts the hijackers head-on. Can he rescue all the passengers and thwart the crisis?

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmers role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, she is left alone at home when her husband is away on a work trip. An intruder enters Bos house and takes her hostage. As Bo tries to survive his mental and psychological torture, she discovers her husbands secret which is related to the accident leading to her blindness

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Changan, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: The first spy thriller movie by famous Director Zhang Yi Mou, this film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932. Sold out by a traitor, the agents, who split up into two teams, find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides. Can they complete their mission?

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kongs Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: Shining For One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the college entrance exam, but an accident changes everything tragically. As Zhang feels helpless and devastated, he fortuitously travels back in time with Lin before the accident happens. Can he make amends and convey his regrets this time?

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wens imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Man On The Edge
programme.desc: On the eve of the 1997 handover, violence is rampant with triad forces causing chaos in Hong Kong. The triad gang leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: A Writers Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellors family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellors daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome Silver Fox and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knights days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master Shadow Whip, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to Shadow Whip?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his Crazy Lo Han Fist improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Thalaivi
programme.desc: J Jayalalithaa, a prolific actress, is encouraged by her mentor, M G Ramachandran, to join politics. However, she faces a difficult challenge in the form of a male-dominated political environment.

programme.title: 35 Chinna Vishayam Illa
programme.desc: Saraswathis happy family is tested when her son Arjun must score 35 in Math to stay in school, despite his lifelong struggle with the subject.

programme.title: Ka Pae Ranasingam
programme.desc: Ariyanachi, a poor woman, strives to bring her deceased husbands body back to India from Dubai, battling the odds of political agenda, corruption and a treacherous bureaucracy that stand in her way.

programme.title: Aadhar
programme.desc: Pharsua becomes the first villager to get an Aadhaar card, but when a superstition links its number to his wifes fate, he embarks on a comic quest to change it.

programme.title: Heartiley Battery
programme.desc: Sophia always grew up believing that love is nothing but a figment of science. At 24, she builds a Love Meter to evade heartbreaks and meets Sid, a free-spirited writer, who soon falls for her.

programme.title: Narathan

programme.title: Rajini Murugan
programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: 钟馗娘子

programme.title: 洪拳与咏春

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活泼且无畏的乡村少女，面对恶霸从不退缩，总是勇敢反抗当她揭露了唐家大少爷的阴谋后，立刻引来他的狠毒报复幸好，她心仪的男子大海及时挺身而出相救两人能否携手对抗险恶命运，改写结局？

programme.title: 西游记
programme.desc: 本片根据中国经典同名名著改编故事讲述唐僧赴西天取经，中途在五指山收服马骝精；在高家庄收服猪八戒；在流沙河收服沙悟净的种种情节

programme.title: 我为你狂
programme.desc: 的士司机阿发与少女阿霞相爱已久，但发有神经错乱，霞为除心理负担，忍痛分手 发大闹霞家并断指示真心，令霞感动而复合然发却不务正业，令霞甚为反感一次争执间，发狂性大发，霞流产，再次离开发...

programme.title: 影子神鞭
programme.desc: 三十万镖银被持神鞭作武器的劫镖者劫去因神鞭是有影子神鞭之称的武林大师方承天的招牌武器，所以他的嫌疑最大，也因此引来连番追捕自此以后，方消声匿迹十五年后，年轻女子杨寒云突然出现，更拿着与当年一样的神鞭究竟这位女子是谁？影子神鞭的下落又如何？

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在爱情和情感相互交错下，组成多个错综复杂的多角恋情

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 马腾是雍正的密令组织血滴子特务团的其中一位杀手当马腾质疑其特务行动是否有违道义时，却旋即变成被同伴追捕的逃犯

programme.title: 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: 吕紫英陪同父吕天奇到台湾发展，两姐白虹青萍留港继续歌舞生涯白虹认识江庆良后投契相恋，江向老板引荐白虹在歌剧中当主角，老父回来见三位女儿成就，开心不已

programme.title: 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: 三十五岁的男教师林明娶了十七岁的女学生珍珍两人在同一学校上课，隐藏夫妻秘密珍发觉林明常被女生包围，而林又发现珍常被男老师追求，期间笑料百出

programme.title: 五毒天罗
programme.desc: 五毒天罗是武林至毒之物，不知收藏何方五毒教的蛇坛主，要找出天罗所在，独霸武林，误放消息，谓天罗已重现武林，江湖一片风声鹤唳...

programme.title: 双喜临门
programme.desc: 朱国栋和李明珠本打算结婚，无奈双方父母为多年死对头，所以坚决反对婚事于是二人不惜假装自杀有见及此双方家长最终冰释前嫌，答应二人成婚此时，唱片公司宣布会为出栋的歌曲版，最终可谓双喜临门

programme.title: 佛都有火
programme.desc: 故事讲述，某寺青年僧人疯子，性格疯疯癫癫，行为全不符僧人规范该寺主持玄明方丈却认为疯子与佛有缘，并因应其性格与气质，授以癫罗汉拳疯子有了武功后，动辄出拳伤人，方丈只得将其逐出寺门...

programme.title: 鬼屋丽人
programme.desc: 本片是根据聊斋中之书痴改编，故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺负，搬进常闹鬼的孝廉府然后玉柱遇上了颜如玉，二人及后结成夫妇郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉，将其迷奸良金妻妾更毒害如玉，如玉化成厉鬼，将中元良金等人杀害玉柱因如玉已不在人世，不禁一阵辛酸

programme.title: 女儿国
programme.desc: 本片讲述唐僧孙悟空猪八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取经，行至西梁女儿国，国内全是女人，而传宗接代生儿育女全靠招胎泉，饮过这泉水便可成孕，但也只能生女

programme.title: 凤还巢
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦将次女雪娥许配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既愤且恼，对居易讹称长女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成亲居易见雪雁貌丑而痴，吓得留书出走富豪朱焕然对雪娥心仪已久，趁此良机冒充居易，依期迎亲......本片由李香君金峰分饰男女主角，配搭新鲜；而蒋光超与庄元庸一胖一瘦的谐趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮

programme.title: 大杀四方
programme.desc: 故事描述，民初北方军阀混战，民不聊生，纷纷向南逃难，三位青年王绪金正平和鱼汉生，夹在难民群中，来到战区边沿王因出手营救一女难民，致遭地方民团首领陈祖光的手下追捕，幸得风尘女子红菱所救......

programme.title: 奸人鬼
programme.desc: 男孩小吉的父母离异后，希望寻找快乐的人生一天，小吉喜遇好心鬼简人，并结成好友好心鬼决定要帮助小吉的父母复合，令小吉得到真正的快乐

programme.title: 魔剑侠情
programme.desc: 狄龙扮演的小李悄然回到爱侣故园之旁隐居，遥对窗中倩影，而不相见，直至发生危机，小李才露面相告，并且挺身赴难有不少高手为争武林排名而找小李决斗，小李又要对付恶势力庞大的帮主谷峰，于是小李找寻旧友阿飞相助，但阿飞被阴险美女林仙儿所迷，简直变成废人，小李于是揭破这女人的假面目，并且设法使阿飞振作起来

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 闻蜚蛾自幼女扮男装从父习武，后更考得秀才功名，堪称文武全才同窗好友杜子中与魏撰之虽与蜚蛾日夕相对，均不知其是女儿身闻母见女儿年纪不小，不该再扮男装，劝蜚蛾选撰之或子中为夫婿不料蜚娥与二人情谊相同，一时无法抉择，遂决定由天定夺，怎知阴差阳错，选婿之箭落于撰之手中蜚娥后悔不已，才知自己意属子中...

programme.title: 铁扇公主
programme.desc: 唐僧师徒西行取经，受阻于烈火绵延的火焰山，唯有铁扇公主的芭蕉扇方能灭火然而因红孩儿一事，牛魔王夫妇拒不相助孙悟空遂与二人展开三调芭蕉扇的智勇较量越过火焰山后，师徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹设下的长生圈套面对诡计多端的妖精，悟空再施神通，护师脱险

programme.title: 夜守
programme.desc: 一场可怕车祸后失忆的王人杰，找到一份废弃大厦的夜间警卫工作当晚交接的老守卫举止怪异，数小时后竟陈尸密室，王人杰瞬间成为头号嫌疑犯诡异事件接连发生，旧日恩怨与冤魂浮现，三只厉鬼如约而至，揭开一场蓄谋已久的复仇计划接踵而来的厄运，究竟是命运还是诅咒？

programme.title: 龙虎武师
programme.desc: 香港动作电影向来以龙虎武师的真功夫蜚声国际这部纪录片向过去所有的龙虎武师致敬，并用上超过两年时间梳理了海量的影像资料，更采访了无数动作特技演员分享拍摄时的辛酸事迹，当中包括著名武打巨星成龙甄子丹及洪金宝

programme.title: 开棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盗墓团伙重现江城，再次下墓摸金怎料四名盗墓贼在开棺时遇惊魂邪煞，逃离后又接连惨死家中最终古墓尸毒和针孔成为留给员警沈春合仅有的线索，看似普通的盗墓案，瞬间扑朔迷离疑点重重

programme.title: 烈探
programme.desc: 警探张荼为救落入人贩之手的儿子，不惜孤身深入敌穴，跨国追击，但却被牵扯进大型儿童拐卖案在寻找儿子的过程中，他和身份神秘的女子携手捣毁了一个大型国际犯罪集团，上演了一场惊心动魄的绝地生死营救

programme.title: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年
programme.desc: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑

programme.title: 新少林寺
programme.desc: 骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎

programme.title: 马永贞
programme.desc: 从山东逃难至上海的马永贞，因救了势力人士谭四而受到赏识，又从黑帮头子杨双手上夺取了他在上海的第一个地盘，从此平步青云杨双与巡捕房勾结，谋害谭四并派人伏杀马永贞

programme.title: 玻璃樽
programme.desc: 台湾女孩阿不前往香港，寻找漂流玻璃樽中那封浪漫纸条的作者阿拔谁料现实阿拔与幻想的相差甚远，让她心碎失望决定黯然返乡就在命运的转角，她遇上富豪企业家陈子午，就此展开一段意想不到的爱情故事

programme.title: 裂战
programme.desc: 科学家颜欣培育出超级橡胶种子，赴毒贩横行的极端之地试种国际安保队长林翔奉命率队保护前妻及其科研团队，众人刚抵达便遭跨国毒枭围剿林翔带领生死弟兄，在吞噬人命的法外之地与多方势力周旋，誓与敌人玉石俱焚

programme.title: 大魔术师
programme.desc: 军阀雷大牛手握重兵，权倾一方，却始终无法赢得三姨太柳遥的芳心此时，神秘魔术师张贤凭惊世古彩戏法名动京城，并受邀入雷府表演表面卖艺的他，实则是柳遥昔日未婚夫在这场真假难辨的奇幻博弈中，张贤暗藏着偷天换日的救人与复仇计画

programme.title: 冰封侠重生之门
programme.desc: 明朝锦衣卫贺英被诬陷为弑君逆贼，三位结义兄弟奉命追杀在生死对决之际，四人意外被冰封于时空裂隙四百年后，他们在现代香港苏醒一场跨越时代的宿命之战，于陌生都市再度引爆

programme.title: 撞邪先生
programme.desc: 美容院职员曾小雨机缘巧合之下，认识了富豪之子利志，以为交上好运岂料利志的父亲是茅山高人，在南洋大败一降头师时，被下咒绝子绝孙，让利志每次恋爱皆遭恶鬼破坏，无疾而终小雨深爱利志，找大法师沈慈航帮助，授以五色驱邪带，两人顺利结婚新婚之夜，利志遗失了驱邪彩带，果然恶鬼来犯...

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 摄影师陈志成长年被一名红衣女子纠缠，导致多位亲人惨死；甚至连自己心仪的女孩思桐亦难逃恶运志成欲寻找思桐惨死的真相，却揭发关于一场冥婚的秘密...

programme.title: 非法移民
programme.desc: 改编自真实个案，交织着年青偷渡客的友谊爱情与理想的梦青年张君秋偷渡纽约，一方面要筹钱还给偷渡集团，另一方面希望通过假结婚获得居留权，故不断找寻假结婚物件

programme.title: 无间道 II
programme.desc: 无间道的秘密最终在此前传中揭露 重案组督察黄志诚与黑帮头领韩琛的恩怨和两名卧底陈永仁与刘建明的宿命纠缠何时开始关键原来系于三个人身上：琛妻新任黑帮龙头及重案组高层无间之门亦在这最坏的时代敞开

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像

programme.title: 反收数特遣队
programme.desc: 在金融危机期间，绝大多数香港市民陷入债务困境此时，贵利集团采取无情手段逼迫债务人还款，李探员与其地下部队誓言缉拿这个非法组织的头目

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决

programme.title: 曼谷风云
programme.desc: 地下拳手林枫因拒绝替曼谷黑帮打黑拳，因此被追杀他虽成功逃脱，却失去记忆当林枫开展其新生活时，却被黑帮发现行踪，并找来绝顶打手对付他期间林枫忽然回复记忆，并誓要将黑帮歼灭

programme.title: 少年陈真之乱世英雄
programme.desc: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事

programme.title: 花心大少
programme.desc: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?

programme.title: 关云长
programme.desc: 这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒最后他能否杀出重围？

programme.title: 国产凌凌漆
programme.desc: 一名被重新启用的后备中国特工伪装成猪肉贩，意外被派去追回被盗的恐龙头骨他被派往香港，并在一名暗中为反派效力的女特工协助下展开行动两人在重重背叛与危机中应对挑战，最终对抗幕后黑手，成功夺回国宝并揭露阴谋

programme.title: 风云雄霸天下
programme.desc: 十年前，笃信命理的天下会霸主雄霸请来泥菩萨推算命运泥菩萨预言，若想称霸武林，必须收两位名字分别带有风与云的少年为徒，他们将助他成就霸业，也将左右他一生的命运霸业虽成，预言却骤然逆转，一场由批言引发的武林浩劫，彻底改变了整个武林的命运

programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱幸运星打算骗假飞飞结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计

programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第29集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第7集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第9集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第12集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第30集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第12集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第21集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾......

programme.title: 状王之王 第7集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.desc: 5천년 중국 역사 비틀기부터 2016년 현재 중국의 민낯까지! ALL ABOUT CHINA! 지금까지 당신이 알고 있던 중국은 잊어라! 중국과 한국의 명사들에게 듣는 중국인도 모르는 중국의 진짜 이야기! quot표절 천국이냐 한류를 넘어선 콘텐츠 강국이냐, 대륙의 문화 콘텐츠의 민낯은? 슈퍼 차이나인가 차이나쇼크인가? 미래의 차이나 리포트는?quot 당신이 모르던 진짜 중국에 대한 이야기를 들려준다. 한중 대표 지식인 6인의 버라이어티 강연쇼! 같은 주제에 다른 시각 또는 각자의 관점으로 이야기 하라! 신중한 강연쇼는 통찰력으로 무장한 한국과 중국의 지성 교양인 6인이 출연하여 매회 한국 대툐와 중국 대표 강연자가 한가지 테마를 두고 강연을 펼친다. 다양한 테마는 기본, 한중 양국의 다채로운 시선과 생각을 공유할 수 있는 새로운 형식의 버라이어티 강연쇼로 시청자들에게 다가갈 수 있을 것이다.

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 터닝메카드 R

programme.desc: 英俊的探險人瑞克歐肯納（布蘭登費雪），與他狡猾的同伴比尼（凱文歐康諾），在1923年的一場戰爭中，一起意外發現了被毀壞的哈姆納塔城數年後，當瑞克變成戰俘等待被槍決前，他發現他對該城的發現成為救命的條件，埋藏在哈姆納塔城底下的豐富資源成為尋寶人與考古學家的寶藏，瑞克與一群很不理想的隊員合作，包括美麗但又少根筋的埃及古文化專家艾佛琳卡娜漢（瑞秋懷茲）以及她讓人又愛又恨的哥哥強納森三人的旅程將穿過尼羅河，橫跨寬廣的薩哈拉沙漠，並將經歷許多超出想像的神奇力量但他們不是唯一追尋哈姆納塔城寶藏的隊伍，還有另一隊由美國人組成的探險隊目的與他們相同，目地在奪取被詛咒之城的豐富財寶；除此之外，還有亞爾德拜依（歐德法爾）所領導的木乃伊教派軍隊的阻撓，他們誓死阻止邪惡祭司印何闐復活重回人間

programme.title: 浩克慢遊
programme.desc: 天很藍，世界很大我揹上背包，迎著陽光，享受寧靜五月，稻田由翠青轉為墨綠眼前的這熟悉景致，許久以來，和我們的生活緊密相連農人穿梭田中，白黃色汗衫在大片的綠中，格外明顯上學的小學生急忙跑過旁邊的小徑，差點撞上沾滿泥土的老野狼再仔細觀看，雲的流動，讓陽光在田中染上不同層次的綠，稻浪不規則的轉換樹枝的擺動落葉的方向，讓我看見風心要夠靜，旅行的況味才得以擴展開來童年的旅行叫遠足，關注的是書包得裝滿平日難得吃到的零食，至於去哪裡倒不是那麼重要年輕時的旅行，拚的是疾走的氣勢，一路騎車到墾丁，早上吃完包子，還可以在沙灘上奔跑一整天現在的旅行，我會放慢腳步，聆聽不期而遇的滿滿人情台灣的美，絕對處處充滿驚喜
